# Requirements Gathering Workshop

<!-- BREADRUMB PLACEHOLDER -->

---

> Systematic approach to eliciting, analyzing, and validating business and technical requirements through collaborative stakeholder engagement.

---
page_texts.3:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#purpose]

### Purpose

Gather comprehensive, accurate, and validated requirements through structured stakeholder collaboration and systematic analysis techniques.
page_texts.4:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#objectives]

### Objectives

- Elicit complete and accurate business and technical requirements
- Ensure all stakeholder perspectives and needs are captured
- Validate requirements for clarity, completeness, and feasibility
- Prioritize requirements based on business value and implementation complexity
- Establish requirements baseline and change management processes
page_texts.5:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#success-criteria]

### Success Criteria

- **Complete Requirements**: All functional and non-functional requirements identified
- **Stakeholder Validation**: Requirements validated and approved by all key stakeholders
- **Clear Prioritization**: Requirements prioritized with clear business justification
- **Quality Documentation**: Well-documented, traceable, and testable requirements

---
page_texts.7:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#3-weeks-before-workshop]

### 3 Weeks Before Workshop

**Stakeholder and Context Analysis:**

- [ ] Identify all requirement stakeholders and their roles
- [ ] Analyze business context, objectives, and success criteria
- [ ] Review existing documentation, systems, and processes
- [ ] Understand regulatory, compliance, and policy constraints

**Requirements Framework Setup:**

- [ ] Define requirements categories and documentation standards
- [ ] Prepare requirements elicitation tools and templates
- [ ] Establish requirements traceability and management approach
- [ ] Plan requirements validation and approval process
page_texts.8:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#2-weeks-before-workshop]

### 2 Weeks Before Workshop

**Stakeholder Preparation:**

- [ ] Conduct stakeholder interviews to understand high-level needs
- [ ] Gather existing requirements documentation and analysis
- [ ] Identify requirement dependencies and constraints
- [ ] Prepare stakeholder briefing materials and expectations

**Workshop Design:**

- [ ] Design workshop activities based on requirement complexity
- [ ] Prepare facilitation materials and elicitation techniques
- [ ] Plan requirement documentation and validation activities
- [ ] Coordinate with subject matter experts and business analysts
page_texts.9:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#1-week-before-workshop]

### 1 Week Before Workshop

**Final Preparation:**

- [ ] Complete stakeholder availability confirmation
- [ ] Prepare workshop materials, tools, and technology setup
- [ ] Brief facilitators and analysts on stakeholder dynamics
- [ ] Validate workshop logistics and contingency planning

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#requirements-template-structure]

### Requirements Template Structure

```markdown
## Requirement ID: [REQ-XXX]

### Requirement Statement

**Description**: [Clear, concise requirement statement]
**Type**: [Functional/Non-Functional/Constraint]
**Priority**: [Must Have/Should Have/Could Have/Won't Have]

### Business Context

**Business Objective**: [How this requirement supports business goals]
**Stakeholder**: [Who requested this requirement]
**Business Value**: [Quantified value or benefit]
**Business Risk**: [Risk of not implementing this requirement]

### Detailed Specification

**Acceptance Criteria**: [Specific, testable criteria for acceptance]
**Pre-conditions**: [What must be true before this requirement applies]
**Post-conditions**: [What will be true after requirement is fulfilled]
**Business Rules**: [Any business rules that govern this requirement]

### Technical Details

**Dependencies**: [Other requirements or systems this depends on]
**Constraints**: [Any technical, regulatory, or business constraints]
**Assumptions**: [Assumptions made about this requirement]
**Open Issues**: [Any unresolved questions or concerns]

### Traceability

**Source**: [Origin of this requirement - stakeholder, document, etc.]
**Derived Requirements**: [Requirements that come from this one]
**Related Requirements**: [Other requirements that relate to this one]
**Test Cases**: [Test cases that will validate this requirement]
```

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#user-story-template]

### User Story Template

```markdown
## User Story: [Story Title]

### Story Statement

**As a** [type of user]
**I want** [some goal or objective]
**So that** [some reason or benefit]

### Acceptance Criteria

**Given** [some context or precondition]
**When** [some action is taken]
**Then** [some outcome is expected]

### Additional Details

-   **Priority**: [Must/Should/Could/Won't Have]
-   **Story Points**: [Effort estimation]
-   **Business Value**: [Value score or rationale]
-   **Dependencies**: [Other stories or requirements needed]

### Definition of Done

-   [ ] Functional requirements met
-   [ ] Acceptance criteria satisfied
-   [ ] Code reviewed and approved
-   [ ] Testing completed and passed
-   [ ] Documentation updated
-   [ ] Stakeholder acceptance confirmed
```

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#requirements-elicitation-techniques]

### Requirements Elicitation Techniques

**Structured Interviewing**

- Use open-ended questions to understand needs and context
- Follow up with specific questions to clarify requirements
- Document requirements in real-time with stakeholder validation
- Summarize and confirm understanding regularly

**Collaborative Analysis**

- Use group sessions to leverage collective knowledge
- Encourage building on each other's ideas and insights
- Manage group dynamics to ensure all voices are heard
- Facilitate consensus building on conflicting requirements

**Visual Modeling**

- Use process flows, data models, and wireframes to clarify requirements
- Create visual representations that stakeholders can easily understand
- Validate understanding through visual review and annotation
- Refine requirements based on visual model feedback
page_texts.30:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#common-requirements-challenges]

### Common Requirements Challenges

**Scope Creep**

- **Challenge**: Requirements expanding beyond original scope
- **Solution**: Clear scope boundaries and change control process

**Ambiguous Requirements**

- **Challenge**: Requirements that can be interpreted multiple ways
- **Solution**: Structured acceptance criteria and example scenarios

**Conflicting Stakeholder Needs**

- **Challenge**: Different stakeholders wanting different things
- **Solution**: Structured priority setting and trade-off discussions

**Technical Feasibility Questions**

- **Challenge**: Requirements that may not be technically possible
- **Solution**: Early technical validation and alternative solution exploration

- **Requirements Summary**: Executive overview of captured requirements
- **Priority Requirements List**: High-priority requirements ready for design
- **Stakeholder Sign-off Documentation**: Formal approval and commitment

page_texts.33:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#follow-up-deliverables-within-1-week]

### Follow-up Deliverables (Within 1 Week)

- **Comprehensive Requirements Document**: Detailed specification with all requirements
- **Requirements Traceability Matrix**: Full traceability from business needs to requirements
- **Acceptance Test Plan**: Testing approach and acceptance criteria
- **Change Management Process**: Procedures for handling requirement changes

### Implementation Support (Ongoing)

- **Requirements Clarification Support**: Ongoing clarification as design and development proceed
- **Change Impact Assessment**: Analysis of proposed requirement changes
- **Acceptance Testing Support**: Support during testing and validation phases
- **Requirements Compliance Monitoring**: Ongoing verification that delivered solution meets requirements

page_texts.36:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#requirements-quality-metrics]

### Requirements Quality Metrics

- **Completeness**: All business needs addressed by captured requirements
- **Clarity**: Requirements are unambiguous and understandable
- **Testability**: All requirements have clear, measurable acceptance criteria
- **Traceability**: Clear links from business needs through requirements to tests
page_texts.37:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#stakeholder-satisfaction]

### Stakeholder Satisfaction

- **Requirement Accuracy**: Stakeholders confirm requirements reflect their needs
- **Process Effectiveness**: Stakeholders satisfied with elicitation and validation process
- **Communication Quality**: Clear understanding and agreement on requirements
- **Confidence Level**: High stakeholder confidence in requirements completeness
page_texts.38:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/requirements-gathering.md#implementation-success-indicators]

### Implementation Success Indicators

- **Design Alignment**: Design phase proceeds smoothly based on clear requirements
- **Development Efficiency**: Reduced rework due to comprehensive, clear requirements
- **Testing Effectiveness**: Testing proceeds efficiently with clear acceptance criteria
- **Delivery Success**: Final solution meets stakeholder expectations and requirements
